name: Spell points
author: Alexandria
summary: The standard spell points variant: every character casts from a pool of points instead of spell slots. Pool by caster level (full caster table), cost by spell level, full refill on a long rest.

rules.text: Spells are cast with spell points instead of slots. A spell costs 2 points at 1st level, 3 at 2nd, 5 at 3rd, 6 at 4th, 7 at 5th, 9 at 6th, 10 at 7th, 11 at 8th and 13 at 9th. Your pool grows with your caster level and refills on a long rest. You can cast each spell of 6th level or higher only once between long rests. Half casters count half their level, rounded up; third casters a third.

assistant.player: This table uses spell points instead of spell slots. A spell costs points by its level: 1st 2, 2nd 3, 3rd 5, 4th 6, 5th 7, 6th 9, 7th 10, 8th 11, 9th 13. A long rest refills the pool, and a caster's level caps the highest spell level they can cast. To answer what they can still cast, read my_spell_codex for their pool and known spells.
